title: What if you fell into the Mariana Trench? 🌊
description: The deepest place on Earth is nearly 11 km down. Here's what the water would do to your body on the way to the bottom. #shorts #whatif #ocean #science #marianatrench

scenes.narration: What if you fell into the Mariana Trench?
It's nearly eleven kilometers deep, the deepest place on Earth.
In the first ten meters, the pressure doubles and can burst your eardrums.
By two hundred meters, almost all the sunlight is gone.
Your lungs keep shrinking. The official record on one breath is just 214 meters.
Below a thousand meters, it's pitch black and barely above freezing.
Down here, many animals make their own light to hunt.
At the bottom, the pressure is over a thousand times stronger than at the surface.
That's about eight tons on every square inch of your body.
In 1960, two men made it down inside a steel ball with walls thirteen centimeters thick.
